title: Refrag: що таке default у CS2?
kind: Посібник із CS2; не розбір конкретного матчу
summary: Defaults spread players to collect information and punish aggression, preserving utility for later decisions. Mirage examples cover A ramp, B apartments and mid. Adapt the formation to available resources rather than rushing every round.

title: innersh1ne / SCOPE.GG: гра ZywOo на cs_summit 6 (2020)
kind: Історичний розбір професійної гри в CS:GO; не поточна мета CS2
summary: The analyst documents a Banana molotov extinguished by a T-side smoke. Transferable lesson: observe opposing utility and reconsider your timing. Old grenade lineups and mechanics must not be copied into CS2 without verification.

title: innersh1ne / SCOPE.GG: гра TeSeS на ESL One Cologne EU (2020)
kind: Історичний розбір професійної гри в CS:GO; не поточна мета CS2
summary: A review of TeSeS identifies wasted utility, including failed Nuke molotovs and fire landing in smoke. Transferable lesson: coordinate and practice grenades before committing teammates. This source does not establish current CS2 lineups or winning round calls.
